description: An honest, citation-backed review of what neurofeedback research does and does not support. Explore B2B content for clinicians evaluating equipment.
tagline: Evidence-based neurofeedback research and clinical equipment analysis.
image_alt: Institute of Neurofeedback — evidence-based neurofeedback research.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team ensures every clinical claim is backed by peer-reviewed citations and rigorous research.

editorial.how_we_test: We aggregate and review peer-reviewed neurofeedback research. For equipment comparisons, we evaluate published technical specifications and clinical efficacy studies.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We generate revenue through B2B content and clinician-focused equipment comparison affiliate relationships. We do not accept payment to alter clinical claim outcomes.
editorial.corrections: If you find a factual error or unsupported clinical claim, please contact us. Corrections are reviewed by our team and published transparently.
